licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung line and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker. The English singing translation and the cue words (Mandoline, Str. pizz.) are left out; the piano part imitates Don Giovanni's mandolin over pizzicato strings. The print shows a C time signature, but every bar holds six eighths: the canzonetta is written in 6/8, Mozart's own metre. The small note in bar 10 is an appoggiatura. Playback tempo: a dotted quarter = 48 (♩ = 72), about 1:50, the median of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958 1:50, Giulini 1959 1:50, C. Davis 1973 1:59, Böhm 1977 2:06, Karajan 1985 1:48); Mozart gives the word Allegretto only.
